summary: ~10-minute full-game recording (Prague Lions vs. Brno Alligators, Semifinal 2008), low-res 450x360, single following broadcast/sideline camera on a grass field with an ambulance and cheerleaders in shot. Unusually action-dense for a full game: nearly every ~25s sample lands on a live play — open-field runs, a leaping tackle, sideline chases toward the pylon, goal-line scrums. Camera pans/tracks the ball, going motion-blurred on the fastest plays; pre-snap and between-play frames are static and distant. Strongest recruiting-trailer material is the ball-carrier breakaways (t~260s, t~62s) and the chaotic mid-collision tackle (t~211s). Note: green/white jerseys read 'ALLIGATORS' — the green team is the client (Brno); orange/black is Prague. Low resolution caps portrait/detail use, but the raw athletic action is exactly the historic, visceral energy a hype cut wants.
